results.title: China spends nearly US$1b on Vietnamese durian in first half
results.description: Vietnam, China imported nearly US$988 million worth of Vietnamese durian in the first half of this year, up 43.4 per cent from a year earlier, accounting for almost half of Vietnam's fruit and vegetable exports to the market, customs data showed.
